test_objective: Check that you can delete a batch of entities with the same id

test_cases.name: 006_04_01 Delete a batch of existing entities with the same id
test_cases.doc: Check that you can delete a batch entities with the same id
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/entityOperations/delete'
        method set to 'POST'
        Batch Delete Entities: and
    Query Parameter: entities_ids_to_be_deleted set to '@{entities_ids_to_be_deleted}'
}
